lines.zh: 我一步一顿地走，膝盖很硬
lines.en: I walk in halting steps, my knees stiff
My shadow trails behind, longer than a person

lines.zh: 我走过草丛，草一直不弹回来
lines.en: I pass through grass and it does not spring back
This way of walking was learned

lines.zh: 我没有脚步声，你不该听见
lines.en: I have no footfall, and you should not hear one
I walk the treeline
My arms hang and swing slowly

lines.zh: 我离地一寸，草尖刚够碰到
lines.en: I hover an inch up, just brushing the grass tips

lines.zh: 站着时是影子，走起来才是东西
lines.en: Standing I am a shadow, walking I am a thing

lines.zh: 我走近村子，狗就不叫了
lines.en: I near the village and the dogs go quiet
My direction always has people in it

lines.zh: 我停下的时候，你已经站在那儿了
lines.en: By the time I stop, you are already standing there
I stand and wait for you to move
There is no mouth on this face, and I am watching
My fingers are too long
I tilt my head over, slowly
The forest wind goes around me
I have no breath to spend

lines.zh: 我站在树影里，树影更深
lines.en: I stand in the tree shade, and it deepens
The spacing is exactly right

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像被人摆好的
lines.en: I hold still, like something posed
I wait for you to turn away
The forest wind goes around me.

lines.zh: 我没有眼皮，可我一直没眨。
lines.en: I have no eyelids, yet I never blink.
I stand under the eaves, and they grow darker

lines.zh: 你的心跳隔着树干传过来。
lines.en: Your heartbeat carries through the trunk.
You look up, and I am already looking at you
I was standing still and you did not notice
This face, I have kept it

lines.zh: 我离你这么近，你才看见
lines.en: Only now that I am this close do you see me

lines.zh: 你身后那棵树旁边，一直是我
lines.en: Beside that tree behind you, that was always me

lines.zh: 我们没有见过，可我记得你
lines.en: We have never met, and I remember you
These eyes of mine never blink

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，脖子露出来了
lines.en: When you looked up, your neck showed
Whose face is this? I have forgotten
The light reaches you, not me

lines.zh: 你开口说话，我听不见声音
lines.en: Your mouth moves and I hear nothing

lines.zh: 你身后的影子，多了一个
lines.en: There is one more shadow behind you
I have watched a long while, you only just noticed
You should remember this face
I am only three steps from you

lines.zh: 你回头，我就在原来那里
lines.en: Look back, and I will be right where I was

lines.zh: 你看我的伤口，那里没有血
lines.en: You look at the wound, there is no blood
That weight is not yet enough

lines.zh: 我偏了偏头，仍是那张脸
lines.en: I tilt my head, still that same face
This face has a crack in it
I have remembered your hand
I am a little closer now

lines.zh: 这一下，让我学了你一个动作
lines.en: That taught me one of your movements
I am standing, I did not fall

lines.zh: 你把东西举给一个没有嘴的
lines.en: You offer it to something with no mouth
I will not put my hand out

lines.zh: 你把食物放在地上，我也不会要
lines.en: Leave food on the ground, I still will not want it
Listen, I do not eat
That thing is shaking in your hand

lines.zh: 你的手已经伸出去太久了
lines.en: Your hand has been out too long
Set it down, then move off
Only empty hands can run

lines.zh: 这块肉不如你的腿有分量
lines.en: That meat weighs less than your legs
You hit me and I did not move at all

lines.zh: 我的手已经在你肩上了
lines.en: My hand is already on your shoulder
Do not press against me, I dislike heat

lines.zh: 这一下，我闻到了你的味道
lines.en: At that, I caught your smell

lines.zh: 我退了半步，是为了看清你
lines.en: I stepped back half a pace to see you better
What you touched was not cloth

lines.zh: 你再撞一次，我就不让了
lines.en: Bump again and I stop giving way
The grass goes flat at our feet
Did your hand pass through? No
That contact should tell you something

lines.zh: 我这张脸没有表情，你别等。
lines.en: My face holds no expression; do not wait.

lines.zh: 你的脸很好看，我先借一下
lines.en: Your face is fine, let me borrow it
I have studied human walking a long while

lines.zh: 这张脸下面，什么都没有
lines.en: Under this face there is nothing
Your words will not stay in me
I have no warmth, you would be cold
Up close, I want to copy you
I have your shape memorized
You should not be standing this close
I bend, slower than you would
My fingers are too long to pinch

lines.zh: 它落在我脚边，我没有捡
lines.en: It fell by my foot, I did not take it
I look at it and keep looking
This is of some use to you

lines.zh: 我拿起来，只是想知道重量
lines.en: I lift it only to know its weight

lines.zh: 它在我手里，像被吃掉了
lines.en: In my hand it looks swallowed

lines.zh: 你不该把东西掉在这儿
lines.en: You should not have dropped it here
I have set it back down

lines.zh: 你捡的时候，我看着你的手
lines.en: As you pick it up, I watch your hands

lines.zh: 你走进这片林子，我听见了。
lines.en: You entered this wood. I heard.

lines.zh: 我已经在你旁边站了很久
lines.en: I have been standing beside you a long while
Only you on this road
Your footsteps are too loud
Your body heat is easy to find
I have got my hand up

lines.zh: 我离得很近，你还没发现
lines.en: I am very close, and you have not noticed
I have been right here the whole time
I recognize your gait
The faster you walk, the closer I am
That way is only dark
Did you hear the leaves move
I keep following, neither fast nor slow

lines.zh: 你回头看，我就要再近一点
lines.en: Look back and I will come a little closer

lines.zh: 你跑起来的时候，我也在跑
lines.en: When you run, I run too
I do not pant, you do

lines.zh: 那栋房子的门，我先前就进去了
lines.en: I was in that house before you

lines.zh: 你在屋里转，我在屋外站
lines.en: You move inside, I stand outside
The lamps are going out one by one
I do not need your name

lines.zh: 你的脚步在木地板上太清楚
lines.en: Your steps on the boards are too clear
I put my hand on the door
Count to three and I am gone
There is no other way out
I am on the road you came by
You stray further from the path
I am already behind you
Further on there are no houses

lines.zh: 你停下来的时候，最好别回头
lines.en: When you stop, you had better not look back
My hand presses over your face

lines.zh: 这一下，你的头偏了过去
lines.en: That turned your head aside
You are pressed against a tree

lines.zh: 我的手指掐住了你的肩
lines.en: My fingers clamp your shoulder
No sound, and yet you heard it

lines.zh: 你的挣扎，我几乎没感觉到
lines.en: I barely felt you struggle
That tore your sleeve

lines.zh: 你退了半步，就不见了半步的光
lines.en: You stepped back, and half a step of light went with you

lines.zh: 你的呼吸一停，我就松手
lines.en: The moment your breath stopped, I let go

lines.zh: 你的脖子后面，有我的手指
lines.en: My fingers are at the back of your neck

lines.zh: 我倒退着走，脸一直朝着你
lines.en: I walk backwards, my face always toward you
Now you should remember me
You are on the ground, looking up at me
You did not cry out

lines.zh: 我什么都没做，你已经在喘
lines.en: I did nothing, and you are already gasping
I have been beside that tree all along

lines.zh: 你进门的时候，我已经在了
lines.en: I was there when you came in
There is one more shadow on the window

lines.zh: 我从树林里走出来，很慢
lines.en: I come out of the woods, slowly

lines.zh: 你刚才回头，我就在那儿
lines.en: You looked back just now, and I was there

lines.zh: 雾散了一点，我就露出来了
lines.en: The fog thinned and there I was
Too quiet, even the wind has stopped
The door is open, and I am inside it
I brought no sound with me

lines.zh: 你已经走进我这一片了
lines.en: You have walked into my stretch
I move only after the lights go out

lines.zh: 门缝里有一道影子，很长
lines.en: A shadow in the door gap, very long
I come around from behind the house
The people inside have not noticed me
I move along the wall, slowly

lines.zh: 这一带的路灯都不亮了
lines.en: None of the street lamps here are lit

lines.zh: 我出现在你刚好不看的方向
lines.en: I appear where you happen not to be looking

lines.zh: 火照过来，我的影子长长地拖出去
lines.en: The fire came and my shadow stretched long

lines.zh: 我摔下去，落地没有声音
lines.en: I fell, and landed without a sound

lines.zh: 水不进我的身体，可我也出不去
lines.en: Water does not enter me, and I cannot leave it either

lines.zh: 炸开的光里，谁都不像我
lines.en: In the blast light, nothing looked like me

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过去，钉在后面的树上
lines.en: An arrow went through and stuck in the tree behind

lines.zh: 那股劲儿照出了我本来的样子
lines.en: That force laid my true shape bare

lines.zh: 我不会饿，可我会一直等着
lines.en: I do not hunger, I only keep waiting

lines.zh: 雷亮的一瞬，我离你只有一步
lines.en: In that flash I was one step from you

lines.zh: 这里没有可以站的影子
lines.en: There is no shadow here to stand in
